thread:
Sophie (FinOps): Heads up: nightly reconcile found ~37 invoices with empty 'lines' in NetSuite from 03/19 23:45-00:30 UTC. Revenue gap ~ $18k.

Diego (Integrations): Example webhook wh_1Lm9xZzz999 shows payload truncated in our DLQ (body ends mid-array). Stripe replay shows full payload.

ops-bot: Alert triggered: invoice_count_anomaly net_revenue_delta=-18432 at 2026-03-20T01:12:05Z

Lena (Billing-Eng): If our transform gets partial JSON, it sanitizes lines -> []. That would create a header-only invoice.

Diego (Integrations): Likely cause: in-memory buffer cap (4KB) in proxy HTTP client. It acks upstream even on truncated read.

Marta (Finance Ops): Operational ask: can we backfill before month close? Accounting needs final numbers.

Diego (Integrations): Mitigation plan: 1) disable auto-ack on proxy for Stripe webhooks; 2) stream large bodies to disk when >4KB; 3) add Content-Length vs actual size check and metric stripe.payload_mismatch.

Lena (Billing-Eng): Backfill plan: patch proxy -> staging validation -> prod deploy -> replay events direct to netsuite-worker with --dedupe. Use event.id idempotency.

Diego (Integrations): Estimated ETA: staging validation 1h, prod deploy + smoke 30m, replay ~15-45m. Total ~2.5h. Deploy target 08:30 PST. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/stripe-truncation-2026-03-19

Sophie (FinOps): Schedule OK. Add rollback steps and alert to #finance-incidents if replay mismatches. Notify accounting before backfill.

Marta (Finance Ops): Will hold manual journals until you confirm. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
